_comment: Design intent for the encounter tables. Hand-editable. See docs/oxide/encounter-tool-design.md section 3.2. Thresholds are Ian's house rules; edit them here, never in lint.py. Rules tagged aspirational in lint.py sit beyond what vanilla Platinum does, on purpose.

encounters_acuity_lakefront.intent: The lakefront above Snowpoint: Sneasel's home at 35 with Alolan Ninetales at 20, Absol a 4%.

encounters_eterna_forest.intent: The forest, eight lines: Shroomish and Buneary at home, Sewaddle and Seedot under the trees, Combee in the canopy, Rowlet by day at 10, Seedot and Purrloin by night.

encounters_fuego_ironworks_outside.intent: The ironworks' yard: Magby and Joltik at home, and Larvesta's home moved here from Stark Mountain at 10 (Ian: earlier is harmless), Litten at 10, Charcadet a 4% ember, two fire starters as 1%s.

encounters_great_marsh_1.intent: The Great Marsh's first area, Wooper's home: the marsh cast at a fifth and less, Koffing in the fog at night.

encounters_great_marsh_2.intent: Area two: Croagunk leads, six lines.

encounters_great_marsh_3.intent: Area three, Croagunk's home: three co-equal in the reeds.

encounters_great_marsh_4.intent: Area four: the spread, nobody over 25.

encounters_great_marsh_5.intent: Area five, Yanma's home: the broad shape, eight lines.

encounters_great_marsh_6.intent: Area six: the marsh shape itself, three co-equal faces.

encounters_iron_island_1f.intent: Iron Island's first floor, Togedemaru's home: the iron lines, eight deep.

encounters_iron_island_b1f_left_room.intent: B1F left: Onix leads, six lines.

encounters_iron_island_b1f_right_room.intent: B1F right: three co-equal, Klefki and Carbink behind.

encounters_iron_island_b2f_left_room.intent: B2F left, Lunatone's home at 35: the moon room.

encounters_iron_island_b2f_right_room.intent: B2F right, Solrock's home at 35: the sun room.

encounters_iron_island_b3f.intent: The bottom of Iron Island, Beldum's home at 35: the reason to go down with Riley, Larvitar and Gible in the tail.

encounters_lake_acuity.intent: Lake Acuity's shore: six cold lines, Galarian Mr. Mime dancing on the ice at 15.

encounters_lake_valor.intent: The drained lake, Absol's home at 35: disaster's omen at the crater, Gothita and Vullaby watching.

encounters_lake_verity.intent: The lake shore: Surskit at home by the water, Lotad with it, Skitty by day, Purrloin by night, Buneary a 4% and Mudkip the 1%.

encounters_lake_verity_low_water.intent: The same shore after the lake drains, the same cast: one location name, one capture.

encounters_maniac_tunnel.intent: The Ruin Maniac's tunnel: Hippopotas's home in the sand, Ferroseed at 10 by the cap rule.

encounters_mt_coronet_1f_north_room_1.intent: Mt. Coronet's first room, reachable in the Gardenia split: Bronzor's home, and the mountain's ice arrives early here: Snorunt and Alolan Ninetales at 10, Swinub and Snover behind, Nosepass where its evolution happens.

encounters_mt_coronet_1f_north_room_2.intent: The second north room: six lines, Glimmet at 15.

encounters_mt_coronet_1f_south.intent: Mt. Coronet's south entrance: Glimmet's home in the ore, the mountain's core cast at a fifth each, Snom and Swinub at 5 and Snorunt by night as the ice creeps down.

encounters_mt_coronet_1f_tunnel_room.intent: The tunnel room on the climb: eight lines, Larvitar at 10.

encounters_mt_coronet_2f.intent: Second floor: three co-equal, Larvitar and Ferroseed behind.

encounters_mt_coronet_3f.intent: Third floor: eight lines, the dragons in the tail.

encounters_mt_coronet_4f_room_3.intent: Fourth floor, room three: Carbink leads, Goomy at 15.

encounters_mt_coronet_4f_rooms_1_and_2.intent: Fourth floor, the paired rooms: Bronzor at 35, the cap's edge.

encounters_mt_coronet_5f.intent: Fifth floor, Jangmo-o's home at 35: the dragon floor under the summit.

encounters_mt_coronet_6f.intent: The last floor before Spear Pillar: Jangmo-o co-equal with the mountain's core.

encounters_mt_coronet_b1f.intent: The wet basement with the Feebas water, Goomy's home at 35: Jangmo-o a 1% before its own floor.

encounters_mt_coronet_outside_north.intent: The snowy ledge on the north face: eight cold lines.

encounters_mt_coronet_outside_south.intent: The snowy ledge on the south face: the cold cast, twelve lines, the two dragons as 1%s.

encounters_old_chateau.intent: The haunted house's hall: teacups and candles, and the gas that drifts through the walls at night.

encounters_old_chateau_back_east_room.intent: The back east room: the gas leads, the banshee answers.

encounters_old_chateau_back_middle_east_.intent: Back middle east: three ghosts co-equal.

encounters_old_chateau_back_middle_room.intent: The middle room with the television, Litwick’s home.

encounters_old_chateau_back_middle_west_.intent: Back middle west: Duskull leads for once.

encounters_old_chateau_back_west_room.intent: The back west room: Yamask’s corner.

encounters_old_chateau_corridor.intent: The corridor, Gastly’s home: the gas fills it end to end.

encounters_old_chateau_dining_area.intent: The dining room: candles on the table, six lines, none over 25.

encounters_old_chateau_side_rooms.intent: The side rooms, Misdreavus’s home: three ghosts co-equal.

encounters_oreburgh_gate_1f.intent: The first cave, eight lines: Zubat and Geodude lead, Nacli and Nosepass at home, Makuhita and Phanpy behind, Onix and a Nidoran small.

encounters_oreburgh_gate_b1f.intent: The Rock Smash floor, the same location as 1F so the same capture: Geodude's home, Makuhita beside it, Onix a 4% and Gible a 1% tease of Wayward Cave.

encounters_oreburgh_mine_b1f.intent: The mine, Makuhita's home: Nacli beside it, Zubat and Geodude behind, Phanpy and Nosepass small, Rhyhorn a 4% and Magby a 1% tease of the deeper rock, Onix by night.

encounters_oreburgh_mine_b2f.intent: Deeper, the Onix floor: Onix at 25 with Phanpy at home beside it, the rock lines behind, Rhyhorn and Magby again in the tail, Makuhita by day.

encounters_ravaged_path.intent: The Rock Smash cave, eight lines: Zubat, Geodude and Makuhita co-equal, Wooper in the wet, Nacli and Phanpy by day.

encounters_route_201.intent: The first route, Kaizo-wide: Wooloo and Sentret lead twelve lines, Rookidee by day, Purrloin and Skitty by night.

encounters_route_202.intent: Shinx's route, twelve lines wide: Blipbug beside it, the Nidoran pair small, Budew and Smoliv the 1% teases of the routes ahead, Sewaddle by day, Poochyena by night.

encounters_route_203.intent: The road to Oreburgh: Rookidee and the Nidoran pair at home, Makuhita a preview of the caves, Torchic a 5% starter, Fletchling and Grubbin by day.

encounters_route_204_north.intent: The delay: Route 204 is one capture and this half is in the Gardenia split, so it carries the prizes at real shares: Litten at home at 25, Treecko 20, Snivy 10, Torchic by day at 10, with Sewaddle and Bounsweet at home too.

encounters_route_204_south.intent: Budew's route, twelve lines: Grubbin and Fletchling at home with it, the Floaroma lines at 4-5% as a preview, Snivy the 1%; the plain half of Route 204, so the north half is the one to wait for.

encounters_route_205_north.intent: The damp side before the forest, twelve lines: Lotad at home, Wooper (fully evolved by 20) a regular, Dewpider and Buizel small, Froakie and Popplio the 1%s, Surskit and Wooper by night.

encounters_route_205_south.intent: Floaroma's meadow, twelve lines: Pachirisu, Smoliv and Minccino at home, Skitty a regular, Pawmi and Shinx small, Combee and Pichu the 1%s, Buneary by day, Poochyena by night.

encounters_route_206.intent: Cycling Road's foot, twelve lines: Gligar's home with Ponyta, Stunky under the road, Salandit and Joltik at 5 (both fully evolved by 33), Charmander and Froakie the 1%s.

encounters_route_207.intent: The rocky road above Oreburgh, twelve lines: Ponyta and Vulpix at home, the cave lines spilling out, Houndour a 5%, Charmander and Torchic the 1% fire tails, Vulpix and Houndour by night.

encounters_route_208.intent: The flower road to Hearthome, twelve lines: Fomantis and Flabebe at home, Ralts passing through, the grass starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_209.intent: The road past the Lost Tower: Gothita's home, Glameow (fully evolved by 38) and Koffing (35) arriving by the cap rule, Duskull and Torchic the 1%s, Yamask by night.

encounters_route_209_lost_tower_1f.intent: The Lost Tower's ground floor, Yamask's home: bats and the graveyard ghosts.

encounters_route_209_lost_tower_2f.intent: Second floor: the same ghosts, wider and flatter.

encounters_route_209_lost_tower_4f.intent: Fourth floor: candles lead the climb.

encounters_route_209_lost_tower_5f.intent: The top floor: eight lines, Klefki a 4% before the ruins, Dhelmise a 1% anchor far from any sea.

encounters_route_210_north.intent: Route 210's foggy upper half, the delay: Hawlucha's home, Goomy at 10 in the mist (fully evolved by 50, so here by Byron), Fennekin and Litten at 10 each by day as the prizes.

encounters_route_210_south.intent: Route 210's lower half, Scyther's home; the north half is the delay. Fennekin at 10 as promised, Swablu, Sneasel and Slugma arriving by the cap rule, the fire and grass starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_211_east.intent: Route 211's Celestic half, the delay: Ralts and Ferroseed at home, Rowlet 20 and Litten 15 the prizes, Jangmo-o at 10 by the cap rule.

encounters_route_211_west.intent: Route 211's early half, at the foot of the mountain: Alolan Ninetales at home at 20 (Ian wanted a likely early chance), Mienfoo with it, Snover at 10 as the first snow line, the two Vulpix side by side.

encounters_route_212_north.intent: Route 212's garden half, Emolga's home: the flower lines, Galarian Mr. Mime a 4 by the cap rule, the grass starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_212_south.intent: Route 212's swamp half, Koffing's home: Froakie at 10 in the rain, the marsh cast around it, the water starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_213.intent: The beach: Sandygast and Clobbopus at home on the sand, Dewpider in the pools, Shellos and Buizel out of the water, the water starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_214.intent: The road down to Valor: Rhyhorn and Fennekin at 20, Houndour and Salandit at home behind them, Swinub a 5 by the cap rule, the fire starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_215.intent: The rain route: Vullaby's home at 35 with Castform at 20, Yanma and Koffing in the tail by the cap rule, Wooper by day.

encounters_route_216.intent: The first snow route: Snover and Snom at home, the mountain's cold cast, Litten a 1% fire in the snow.

encounters_route_217.intent: The blizzard route: Swinub and Snorunt at home, Larvitar a 5 by the cap rule (fully evolved by 55), two fire starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_218.intent: The grass by Canalave, reached by Surf: Galarian Mr. Mime's home, the beach lines beside it.

encounters_route_221.intent: The road to Pal Park: Lurantis's home (a line of its own until Fomantis's data is fixed), Trapinch a 5 by the cap rule, the beach lines small.

encounters_route_222.intent: The beach road to Sunyshore, Elekid's home: every electric line at once, the water starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_224.intent: The flower route to Seabreak Path: no line's home, every line a cameo at a new share; Yveltal's static is planned here.

encounters_route_225.intent: The Battle Zone's first route: the early lines back at post-game levels, none a home, Hawlucha in the hills.

encounters_route_226.intent: The cliff route above the sea: eight lines, the birds and the beach.

encounters_route_227.intent: The road up Stark Mountain: Charcadet and Skarmory at home, the fire lines, two fire starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_228.intent: The sandstorm route, Trapinch's home: the desert lines, Beldum at 10, the two pseudo-legendaries as 1%s.

encounters_route_229.intent: The tall-grass route to the Resort Area, Heracross's home: the bug and grass lines, two grass starters as 1%s.

encounters_route_230.intent: The last route, by the sea: Galarian Rapidash's home, Togepi at 20.

encounters_ruin_maniac_cave_long.intent: The cave dug through to the ruins: three co-equal, Klefki by day where it meets the ruins.

encounters_ruin_maniac_cave_short.intent: The cave before the maniac digs through: Dwebble's home at 35, Hippopotas beside it.

encounters_sendoff_spring.intent: The spring at the end of the road: the pseudo-legendaries and the best of the preferred tier, the one table worth the walk.

encounters_victory_road_b1f.intent: The basement with the water: Beldum co-equal with Onix and Nacli.

encounters_wayward_cave_1f.intent: Wayward Cave's upper floor: Carbink's home, Bronzor and the rock lines, Gible a 4% before its own floor, Joltik the 1%.

encounters_wayward_cave_b1f.intent: The hidden floor under Cycling Road is Gible's, at 35, the cap's edge: the reason to bring Flash. Larvitar a 1% tease of Victory Road.

encounters_verity_lakefront.intent: A new capture area (the map still needs grass and its header pointed here): Pikipek and Blipbug at home, eight lines, Minccino by day, Poochyena by night.

splits._comment: Ian's gym splits, in order, each with its hard level cap (null until he gives it) and the split each rod arrives in. Roark and Gardenia are his; the rest are the tool's reading of the route sequence, provisional.
